steps.title: Play first!
steps.text: Press Play. Walk with the arrow keys or WASD, collect the six gems and find the portal. Watch out for slimes!

steps.title: The hero's script
steps.text: Open player.es. on_update runs every frame: it reads the arrow keys with axis() and sets the velocity. The hurt() function is called by slimes when they bump into the hero.

steps.title: Variables you can tweak
steps.text: Variables at the top of a script (like speed and max_health) show up in the Inspector, so you can change them without touching the code. Try giving the hero 5 hearts.

steps.title: Enemies
steps.text: slime.es wanders in a random direction every 2 seconds, and chases the hero when it's closer than 'sight'. Change sight to 8 for scarier slimes.

steps.title: Talking between objects
steps.text: Gems broadcast 'all_gems' when the last one is collected. The portal and the message text both have on_message(name, data), so they react to it.

steps.title: Challenge
steps.text: Add a heart pickup that gives back health: copy a gem (in the Gems folder), change its image to a heart shape, and write a script that does game.health += 1 when the player touches it.
